document: Course Title: Software Development Fundamentals-1 (15B11C1111). Institute: Jaypee Institute of Information Technology, Noida. Exam: Test 1 Examination, ODD 2023 (B.Tech 1st Semester). Max Time: 1 hour. Max Marks: 20.

Q1. Bridge crossing puzzle with 4 people (Alex, Bob, Carol, Dave) walking at speeds 1, 2, 5, 10 mins. Bridge holds max 2 people with 1 flashlight. Total time available is 17 mins. Find shortest time and explain steps.

metadata.subject: SDF1
metadata.co_description: Explain various phases of software development life cycle
